card.name: Partway through drug and metabolite names
card.fires_on: Early or middle pieces of long drug or metabolite names, such as meta- in meta-chlorophenylpiperazine, the start of metoclopramide, or the middle of ifosfamide and pirfenidone. The word is not yet finished and more letters follow.

modes.label: Metabolite names
modes.description: Opening or inner pieces of metabolite names in interaction text.
modes.example: nefazodone (23%) and its metabolites hydroxynefazodone (HO-NEF) (17%) and<< meta>>-chlor

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long generic drug names that are split into parts.
modes.example: Administration of levac<<ety>>lleucine to pregnant rats and rabbits

modes.label: Start of listed drugs
modes.description: First piece of a drug name in a list of drugs.

card.writes: It seems to push the model to continue with the next letters of a drug name, not a common word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long drug name, when the rest of the name still has to be spelled out.
